summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Payment (SO) updates (grouped W9 header, date filters on client + officer views, 4 downloads, add/edit/delete regression) via Playwright on the public preview URL as admin@example.com. All 5 requested feature areas passed; no console errors, no error elements, no broken flows found.

issues: Custom range uses native HTML date inputs (browser default picker) rather than the shadcn calendar used elsewhere in the app. This matches the stated requirement ('manual date range inputs') so treated as a cosmetic consistency note only.

critical_code_review_comments: DateRangeFilter passes a fresh object to onChange on every keystroke of the custom date inputs; ClientView/OfficerDetail useEffect depends on the range object so each partial date entry triggers an API call. Consider debouncing the custom-range fetch (client view debounces only when `search` is set).
Selecting the 'Custom' preset with empty From/To immediately re-queries with an empty range (equivalent to All Time) - acceptable but produces one extra request.
seed_data_creation: Created two temporary payment entries for officer John Doe (W2 2026-07-15 $77 -> edited to $88 via officer-detail Add Payment, and W9 Direct Deposit 2026-07-20 $55 via client-view Add New Payment). Both were deleted after verification; client grand total restored to $6499.00 and John Doe total to $6049.00.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on preview URL: (1) so-records-table has 2 header rows - R1 ['SL','Security Officer Name','Address','Social Security','W2','W9'(colspan=3),'Total (W2+W9)','Action'], R2 ['Direct Deposit','Zelle Transfer','W9 Total']; data rows have 10 tds, footer uses colSpan=4 + 6 cells = aligned. (2) Client totals unfiltered W2 $3100 / DD $2799 / Zelle $600 / W9 $3399 / Grand $6499; Last 30 Days -> 1 row $2399; Custom 2026-06-01..06-30 -> 1 row $1500 (matches backend expectation). (3) Officer detail (John Doe, 5 entries, total $6049) has so-officer-date-filter with all 7 presets; Last 3 Months -> $6049, Custom June -> 1 entry $1500 and Statement Period header updates to 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30. (4) All 4 downloads succeeded with a date filter active: Payment-Arseas Security.pdf/.xlsx, Payment-John Doe.pdf/.xlsx. (5) Payment dialog has only Payment Type / Date / Amount columns - no Transaction ID; add, edit (amount 77->88) and delete all worked with success toasts; officer search returned 2 options; record search 'John' narrowed to 1 row.
